title: Allahabad University PGAT 2026 Online Counselling
vacancyDetails: Online counselling for MA, M.Sc, M.Com, MBA, MCA, LLB/LLM, M.Ed and other PG programmes
qualification: Graduation with subject eligibility + PGAT 2026 qualification as applicable
ageLimit: As per AU PG admission rules
applicationFee: Counselling / admission fee as per university notice
selectionProcess: PGAT Exam → Result → Online Counselling Registration → Document Upload → Seat Allotment → Fee Payment
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://allduniv.ac.in PG Admission 2026-27 page
2. Open PG Online Counselling at https://ecounselling.in/
3. Register, upload documents, pay fee
4. Check merit/cutoff and complete admission
5. Contact helpline if needed
shortDescription: Allahabad University PGAT 2026 Online Counselling started – register at ecounselling.in / allduniv.ac.in for PG courses.
content:
University of Allahabad has activated PGAT 2026 online counselling for postgraduate admissions (session 2026–27).

PGAT results were declared earlier; counselling registration, document upload and fee payment are online via ecounselling.in linked from allduniv.ac.in.
